headline: Real Madrid had 24 shots to Celta's 8 and 3.75 xG to 1.64, missed a penalty and 5 big chances, and needed two goals after the 57th-minute triple sub to win 2-1.

tactical_change.trigger: triple substitution at 57': Cucurella, Valverde and Vinícius Júnior on (ESPN lineups; report: Vinícius on at 57'). Who Vinícius replaced is disputed between ESPN lineup and report, so don't say it.
tactical_change.effect: Up to 57': 15 shots, 3 on target, 0 goals. After 57': 9 shots, 4 on target, 2 goals. Celta after 57': 2 shots. Both goals involved Vinícius per the ESPN report (set up the move for Bellingham's equaliser; cross for Espí's header before the rebound winner).

best_player.name: Vinícius Júnior
best_player.why: Scout's pick. Off the bench at 57' (first game after a four-match ban, ESPN report) and the team's highest xA (0.71) and most big chances created (2) in about half an hour. Report: helped set up the equaliser and crossed for Espí's header before the winner. Note ESPN credits him 0 assists.
best_player.source: https://www.espn.co.uk/football/player-stats/_/gameId/401882798 (data/research/scrape_20b27ea37a9c.json, Vinícius row: TCH 26, A 0, xG 0.01, xA 0.71, SHOT 1, BCC 2); ESPN report (data/research/scrape_2b49b105c142.json)

worst_player.name: Kylian Mbappé
worst_player.why: Scout's pick. Played 90 minutes, four shots, none on target, 0.89 xG, and blazed the 39th-minute penalty over the bar at 0-1. Fair balance: ESPN credits him the assist for Bellingham's equaliser (A 1, xA 0.42).
worst_player.source: https://www.espn.co.uk/football/player-stats/_/gameId/401882798 (data/research/scrape_20b27ea37a9c.json, Mbappé row: TCH 51, G 0, A 1, xG 0.89, xA 0.42, SOG 0, SHOT 4); shots_espn.json shot 15 (39', Penalty, Off Target, 0.79 xG); ESPN report 'sent his penalty sailing over the crossbar'

surprise_stat.label: touches for Carlos Espí, one of them the winner
surprise_stat.context: On at 79'; ESPN player stats TCH 5, G 1, SHOT 2, SOG 2. Report: 'only been on the field for six minutes' when he scored at 85'.

result_context.table: Real Madrid level with Barcelona on 33 points (Madrid 13 played, Barcelona 12), ESPN match page LALIGA table + ESPN report; Barcelona play Villarreal Sunday

caveats: No player ratings on the web path: best/worst are Scout's pick from ESPN player stats.
No BBC match page found; the cached BBC URL in _web_sources.json is Osasuna v Málaga (only its La Liga table used).
Shot-map xG sum for Madrid is 4.13 vs ESPN header 3.75 (rebound double-count); use 3.75 on screen and shot counts, not xG sums, for splits.
Who Vinícius replaced at 57' is disputed (ESPN lineup: Alexander-Arnold; ESPN report: Bernardo Silva).
ESPN credits Vinícius 0 assists; say 'set up' / big chances / xA, not 'two assists'.
Red line: the ESPN report mentions a pre-match tribute to a deceased Tenerife player. Never reference it.
No Firecrawl research in this step (data from free ESPN fetches).
